links.outcome: Change in radiologist report-drafting time after AI lung nodule deployment, by hospital
links.effect: Pooled increase of 0.86 min (95% CI 0.14 to 1.57). Tsinghua Changgung: nonsignificant +0.90 min. Beijing Anzhen: reductions of 0.76 min at year 1 and a further 1.83 min at year 2 (about 28% time saved).
links.quote: AI-assisted lung nodule diagnosis may initially increase report-drafting time due to adaptation and workflow adjustment.

screen.reason: Evaluates the real-world operational impact (report-drafting efficiency) of deploying an AI-assisted lung nodule diagnosis tool across two hospitals over time, without testing a specific deployment practice or guardrail.
